title: Strong finite-time RPCD distance target
statement: For every real unit-diagonal SPD A, mu=lambda_min(A), fresh independent uniform permutations each epoch, every x0, and every k>=0, prove E||x_k||_A <= C exp(-c mu k)||x0||_A for universal numerical c,C>0, hence O((n/mu) log(1/epsilon)) coordinate updates.

signature.representation: Fresh-permutation RPCD epochs on a normalized positive-definite quadratic
signature.state_or_invariant: Expected A-distance for every deterministic initial point
signature.core_candidate_lemma: Any accepted child route must provide dimension-uniform positive epoch contraction and transient constants together with a valid strong-expectation transfer.
information_retained: unit-diagonal normalization and normalized spectral floor mu
all initial points and all epoch counts
expectation of A-distance rather than distance of the expected iterate
information_discarded: No proof representation or surrogate is selected at L0.
signature.target_implication: An epoch count O(mu^-1 log(1/epsilon)) multiplies by n coordinate updates per epoch.
signature.known_failure_mode: A route may prove only fixed-initial, asymptotic, squared-distance, or norm-of-expectation contraction and silently overstate it as the L0 target.
